title: Snap Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Snap Inc filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing the departure of Chief Financial Officer Derek Andersen effective May 8, 2026, and the planned appointment of Doug Hott, currently Vice President of Finance, Strategy, and Corporate Development, as his successor. This is a standard corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: CFO Derek Andersen departing Snap Inc effective May 8, 2026 for a new opportunity
Andersen confirmed departure is not related to any disagreement on accounting, strategy, or operations
Doug Hott appointed as successor CFO; currently VP of Finance, Strategy and Corporate Development since July 2024
Hott holds B.S. in Physics (Bradley University), M.S. in Astrophysics and M.B.A. (University of Cincinnati)
Filing made pursuant to SEC regulations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
